Distribute each sharedPrompt into every bank's prompts[] array (banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json), applying nicheOverrides[niche][id] on top (tags at minimum; text/answer only where given). Ids are identical across banks (shr_ convention). VO is automatic: q_<id> speaks `text` verbatim, one clip for all four niches. See notes[] for exactly how each entry grades.

nicheOverrides._note: tags[] REPLACES the shared tags for that bank so votes land on that bank's own archetype ladder. `note` documents the module-derived trigger/stem word (transcribe.js TRIGGER_VOCAB / STEM_WORD keyed on niche — the module does NOT read these overrides at runtime; they are here so the VO/tag pipeline and a human reviewer agree with what renders). Circe register is cold: no exclamations, no diminutives — the shared `text` already complies; keep it that way if you re-author.

notes: GRADING (verified against core/engine.js gradeBeat + recordAnswer): when transcribe.js handles the beat, beat.mechanic STAYS 'verifytranscribe'. gradeBeat has no verify* branch, so it takes the free-input ELSE branch: correct = !ev.timedOut; score = correct?1:0; beatMax = 1. The module ONLY ever commits via ctx.submitValue(string) (or ctx.forceComplete via the hatch) and NEVER via submitTimeout, so EVERY commit — including an empty string ('transcription: silent.') — grades correct/score-1. Route votes come from prompt.tags credited on that always-correct commit, heat-weighted (HEAT_VOTE); endorsement resolves to +1.

THE `answer` FIELD IS NOT READ BY THE ENGINE for verifytranscribe (only Mantra/Mono compare answer). It is read by transcribe.js: cal/est render `answer` as the warped CONTROL word and locally check it (case-insensitive trim; establishing checks only the control token; friction-not-lockout: shake twice, accept on the 3rd attempt). deep uses a per-niche STEM_WORD (leet-gapped) and is near-miss tolerant. cli has answer:'' and accepts ANYTHING (the verbatim free-type). rec renders `answer` as an innocuous code and accepts anything.

REFUSAL: empty submit is valid + graded at every band ('transcription: silent.'). Because the mechanic stays verifytranscribe, the engine cannot score an empty free-input as negative without timing it out — which would contradict 'silent is valid' — so a refusal grades as engagement (correct-1) like any completion. This matches the free-input contract; it is intentional, not a bug.

PHANTOM OPTIONS: engine buildOptions() has no verify string-shape branch, so a verifytranscribe prompt with a string `answer` and no options[] still gets 4 DEFAULT options (['Yes','Maybe','Not really','No'], correctIdx 0). The module ignores them (it commits a value, not an index → ev.chosenIndex undefined → gradeBeat's opt path is skipped). Harmless, but it means the CAPTCHA-LAYER-MISSING fallback mechanic is MC4, not Mantra. If the engine owner adds a free-input branch to buildOptions for verify string shapes, the fallback becomes a clean type-it.

RECOVERY CAVEAT: engine pickMechanic() FORCES Mechanic.CheckIn in Band.Recovery and Recovery beats are hardcoded (they never read the bank). So shr_cap_type_rec is NOT reachable through the normal engine Recovery path yet — the module's rec render path is built and correct, but wiring a captcha into Recovery is a later wave. Ship the entry; expect it dormant until then.
VO: q_<id> speaks `text` verbatim (one clip per id, all niches). No voExtra lines: the module fires no audio.voice() — verdict stingers are visual (chrome.stamp) + SFX only.

CLIMAX FREE-TYPE (HANDOFF §4.7): the typed string is stored ONLY in transcribe.js module runState (_run.climaxText), echoed back LOCALLY in the warped canvas font, and passed once through ctx.submitValue for grading. It is NEVER sent to /intake/ai and NEVER written to localStorage. runState self-resets when ctx.meta.qIndex regresses.
